name: binary_modmul_full_mt
description: Complete deterministic 5-tape TM for (a*b) mod p. The finite control includes the outer loop/controller and in-place shift, increment, add, compare, and subtract subroutines; no external arithmetic orchestration is required.

input_convention.tape_2_P: W LSB-first modulus digits, zero-padded, followed by #
input_convention.tape_4_R: W zero digits followed by #; final result is here LSB-first
